description: Dictation fixture clips for the transcription bake-off (WER, real clips only) and the clean-up scorer (fillers removed, must-keep kept). Real clips come from AMI (CC BY 4.0) and VoxPopuli (CC0 1.0); synthetic clips are text-to-speech readings of scripted hesitant text, used for filler scoring only. Synthetic entries are written by apps/api/scripts/dictation-synth-clips.ts. apps/web/src/tests/e2e/fixtures/dictation-en.wav is clip en-ami-10 as 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM, for Chromium's fake microphone in the Playwright dictation scenario (same source, licence and attribution).
